deskripsi: Grasshoppers are voracious chewing defoliators that feed on rice leaves and sever developing panicles, causing dramatic reduction in photosynthetic leaf area and unfilled grains.
pengendalian_ipm: Biological control utilizing entomopathogenic fungus Metarhizium anisopliae.
Botanical neem-based repellent or bio-pesticide foliar spray.
Deployment of nocturnal light traps along field borders to catch adults.

deskripsi: Microscopic migratory endoparasites that penetrate epidermal cells of rice roots, causing characteristic hook-like terminal swellings, cortical necrosis, nutrient deficiency, and severe plant stunting.
pengendalian_ipm: Intermittent field drying and drainage to disrupt aquatic nematode movement.
Crop rotation with non-host leguminous or cover crops.
Application of bio-nematicides or targeted Fluopyram treatments.

deskripsi: Larvae bore into the central culm, severing vascular bundles. Causes 'Deadheart' (drying of central whorl) in vegetative stage and 'Whitehead' (empty, bleached panicles) during reproductive stage.
pengendalian_ipm: Field release of Trichogramma japonicum egg parasitoids.
Installation of synthetic sex pheromone delta traps to disrupt mating.
Application of systemic chlorantraniliprole at peak egg hatching.

deskripsi: Adults and nymphs insert piercing-sucking stylets into milky developing rice grains, extracting liquid endosperm and causing empty, chalky, or shriveled grains with pungent odor.
pengendalian_ipm: Synchronous community planting within a 2-3 week window.
Frequent weeding of surrounding gramineous grasses harboring alternative hosts.
Application of entomopathogenic fungus Beauveria bassiana or odor bait traps.

deskripsi: Phloem-feeding sap suckers congregating at plant bases. Causes 'Hopperburn' (extensive circular patches of wilting and drying) and acts as the vector for Rice Grassy Stunt Virus (RGSV).
pengendalian_ipm: Conservation of natural predatory mirid bugs (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis) and spiders.
Avoidance of excessive nitrogenous fertilizer application.
Cultivation of resistant rice varieties carrying Bph gene complexes.

deskripsi: Systemic vascular bacterial infection that produces water-soaked to yellowish wavy stripes along leaf margins, progressing to gray-white foliar necrosis and extensive canopy blight.
pengendalian_ipm: Balanced NPK fertilization; avoiding excess urea during high humidity.
Application of copper-based bactericides or validamycin during early lesion emergence.
Adoption of certified blight-resistant cultivars (e.g. Inpari 32).

deskripsi: Panicle fungal pathogen that converts individual spikelet florets into large, powdery, velvet-textured spore balls transitioning from orange/yellow to greenish-black.
pengendalian_ipm: Preventive foliar spraying of copper oxychloride or azoxystrobin at late booting stage.
Utilization of certified pathogen-free seeds treated with seed dressers.
Controlled field irrigation to reduce continuous canopy humidity during heading.

deskripsi: Devastating ascomycete fungus forming elliptical diamond/spindle-shaped lesions with grayish-white centers on leaves and collar, leading to catastrophic 'Neck Blast' and total lodging.
pengendalian_ipm: Targeted application of tricyclazole, isoprothiolane, or trifloxystrobin at heading.
Application of soluble silica fertilizer to reinforce epidermal cell walls.
Utilization of multi-line resistant varieties and seed disinfection.

deskripsi: Vector-transmitted viral disease causing extreme plant stunting, erect growth habit, profuse tillering (grass-like clump), narrow pale leaves, and complete failure of panicle emergence.
pengendalian_ipm: Strict population suppression of brown planthopper (BPH) vectors.
Immediate rouging and burying of infected plants exhibiting grassy clumps.
Synchronous planting and adherence to a 1-month crop-free fallow period.

deskripsi: Composite viral syndrome transmitted semi-persistently by green leafhoppers, characterized by yellow-to-orange leaf discoloration starting from leaf tips, leaf twisting, and stunted growth.
pengendalian_ipm: Targeted management of green leafhopper (GLH) vectors using systemic insecticides or neem oil.
Cultivation of tungro-resistant rice cultivars (e.g. Inpari 36, Inpari 37 Lanrang).
Synchronous community planting and adjusting the planting calendar to avoid peak vector flights.
